capabilities: Show every note matching a clicked calendar date, from any folder
Browse indexed notes in a collapsible list by year, quarter, month, or week
Match notes by frontmatter date fields, filename date formats, or file creation date
Limit indexing and list display with include/exclude folder scope rules
Create daily and weekly notes using Daily Notes or Periodic Notes settings
extras: Installs via BRAT for latest-commit builds; the author includes a buy-me-a-coffee donation link and lists other plugins by the same author. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer.
intentEvidence: Calendar Hub is a fork of Liam Cain's Calendar, so everything you expect still works
problem: Standard calendar plugins only map the one configured Daily Note per day, so daily logs, meeting notes, and other dated notes scattered across folders stay invisible.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on Liam Cain's original Calendar plugin for Obsidian
When Periodic Notes is not managing weekly notes, the Weekly note format, template and folder

summary: Fork of the Calendar plugin that shows every note matching a calendar date via frontmatter, filename, or creation date, plus a list view by period.
